same_shape_different_meaning.text: 我们认为留存下降的主因是上手困难，而不是价格太高。
下周三前完成新手引导改版，周五发给二十个老用户试用并收集反馈。
“激活”指新用户在第一周内完成至少一次有价值的操作。
访谈中有七位用户提到第一次打开后不知道从哪里开始。
价格调研显示多数用户认为现价合理。

loop.step: drag-select part of a paragraph (22 characters)
loop.result: row: 一段文字 · 留存分析 | 改得更简洁 | 解释 | 展开论述 | 更多 | 按规则

loop.step: real click on 改得更简洁
loop.result: editor keeps focus; popup 改得更简洁 · 正在处理 at the frozen range; frozen range marked

loop.step: click into the heading while waiting
loop.result: row goes idle (nothing in hand); frozen range stays

loop.step: candidate arrives: buttons 取消 / 替换; click 替换
loop.result: only the 22 frozen characters replaced; rest of the paragraph, heading and first paragraph unchanged; saved (已保存); frozen range released

loop.step: 更多 → grouped by intent (改写 / 质疑 / 组织) then 全部操作; choose 解释 (a result)
loop.result: candidate with 取消 / 插到后面; 插到后面 adds a new paragraph after the frozen one, original unchanged, saved
focus moves to the first action, then the next; Esc returns to the editor with the selection intact
row keeps two actions and 更多 right above the input; no horizontal overflow

loop.step: a Home without a text model
loop.result: every Pages action is unavailable (请先配置文字模型，再使用写作助手), so the row stays quiet
